newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates remain low on surplus funds.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates remain low on surplus funds.

text.p: Pakistan's money market rates remained low on Wednesday amid excess liquidity despite an open market operation by the central bank, dealers said.
"The liquidity remained present in the system and despite today's open market operation, the overnights were traded between the levels of one and three percent," a dealer said.
Dealers said heavy amounts were dealt at around two percent and the market closed long.
One-week bids were quoted at 12 and 15 percent, but lenders showed interest around 19 percent.
One-month repos were mismatched with bids and offers at 15.75 and 16.50 and three-month borrowers could not cover their positions at 15.25 percent as the offers were at 16 percent, the dealers said.
In Wednesday's open market operation, the State (central) Bank of Pakistan could only procure 50 million rupees for a five-month repo at 16 percent, they said.
